title: KCP events_read request (DESIGN.md §11.3, §11.4, §11.6.1 read family)
description: Read: never mutates authoritative or user-visible state and never carries meta (closed shape — a read carrying meta, hence an idempotency key, fails; §11.2, R0 KENV-01). Durable event read from the last cursor; the §11.4 arg list verbatim (gap note KG28). Clients always recover via events_read; the realtime socket is an optimization (§11.4). Revocation applies to replay as well as live data (§11.4). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal; connector service (only for its mapped resources) (assurance: current login or workload identity). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

source.description: Event source selector (§11.4); opaque — the public cursor encodes source stream, sequence, snapshot epoch, and filter boundary and is never a NATS sequence (§11.3).

project_id.description: §11.4 spells project_id inside the events_read args (verbatim); it narrows the read to one project and never widens past the envelope scope (gap note KG28).

type_prefixes.description: §11.4 type_prefixes; at most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

args.description: §11.4 events_read args verbatim: { source, after_cursor?, project_id?, type_prefixes?, limit }.

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

eventTypePrefix.description: Reverse-domain event-type prefix filter (§11.4 type_prefixes); filters narrow, never widen, the authorized delivery set (gap note KG28).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

pageLimit.description: Explicit page read limit; at most 512 (§11.8).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).
